data.one_liner: Toolkit for Flutter widget tests with chainable selectors and automatic timeline reports.
data.what_it_does: Spot simplifies queries and assertions against the widget tree using a chainable selector API called spot. It visualizes test steps and assertions as an HTML timeline report complete with automatic screenshots.
use_when: You want more readable and chainable widget queries in Flutter widget tests
You need automatic screenshots and HTML timeline reports for failing tests
avoid_when: You prefer using standard flutter_test finders and matchers exclusively
strengths: Chainable selectors for precise widget queries
Automatic HTML timeline generation with screenshots on test failure
Clearer error messages and full widget tree dumps
weaknesses: Adds an opinionated testing wrapper over the built-in flutter_test package
data.setup_notes: Add spot to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and optionally load app fonts in tests using loadAppFonts().
